readme:
# Douban Subject Details API

Get the public detail page data for a Douban movie or TV subject by subject ID. Use it to inspect a known title before requesting its reviews or comments.

The response is the platform's original data structure.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/douban/subject-detail" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"subjectId": "1292052"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subjectId` | string | Yes | The unique ID for a movie or TV subject on Douban. |

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls and empty results are not charged.
